title: No More Manual Tests? Evaluating and Improving ChatGPT for Unit Test Generation
abstract: Empirical study evaluating ChatGPT for unit test generation on 13 OSS Java projects. Quantitative analysis of correctness sufficiency readability usability. Passing tests achieve comparable branch coverage to manually-written tests. User study with 5 Java developers.
authors: Yuan Z.; Lou Y.; Liu M.; Ding S.; Wang K.; Chen Y.; Peng X.

title: An Empirical Evaluation of Using Large Language Models for Automated Unit Test Generation
abstract: Evaluates GPT-4 Claude 3.5 Command-R Llama 3.1 for automated unit test generation in Java and Python real-world projects. Measures code coverage and mutation score. GPT-4 top performer. Java outperforms Python consistently.
authors: Schafer M.; Nadi S.; Eghbali A.; Tip F.

title: An initial investigation of ChatGPT unit test generation capability
abstract: Evaluates OpenAI LLM for Java unit test generation on 33 programs. Best result temp=0.6: 93.5% code coverage and 58.8% mutation score. Similar performance to EvoSuite and Randoop traditional tools.

title: Mutation-Guided Unit Test Generation with a Large Language Model (MUTGEN)
abstract: Proposes MUTGEN mutation-guided LLM test generation approach. Key finding: some test suites achieve 100% branch coverage but only 4% mutation score. MUTGEN significantly outperforms EvoSuite and vanilla LLM prompting on mutation score. Java 204 subjects.
authors: Wang G.; Xu Q.; Briand L.; Liu K.

title: Effective test generation using pre-trained Large Language Models and mutation testing
abstract: Uses mutation testing feedback to guide pre-trained LLM test generation. Mutation feedback loop iteratively improves fault detection. Java OSS benchmark. Mutation score primary metric.
authors: Dakhel A.M.; Nikanjam A.; Majdinasab V.; Khomh F.; Desmarais M.C.

title: Multi-language Unit Test Generation using LLMs (aster)
abstract: aster framework for LLM-based test generation in Java SE/EE and Python. GPT-4-turbo outperforms EvoSuite. Compares against developer-written tests. Naturalness metrics included. Java branch+mutation Table 3.

title: On the Evaluation of Large Language Models in Unit Test Generation
abstract: Comprehensive evaluation of LLMs including GPT-4 on Java Defects4J. Branch coverage and mutation score both measured. Coverage-only metrics insufficient. GPT-4 mutation score 61.2%.
authors: Chu Z.; Zhou J.; Liang G.; Wang Q.; Chen J.

title: Benchmarking LLMs for Unit Test Generation from Real-World Functions (ULT)
abstract: ULT benchmark for Python function-level unit test generation. High cyclomatic complexity controlled. 12 LLMs evaluated. Branch coverage avg 30.22%; mutation score avg 40.21%. Python high CC challenging.
authors: Huang D.; Zhang J.M.; Harman M. et al.

title: Harnessing Large Language Models for Automated Software Testing
abstract: 16 LLMs evaluated. GPT-4 achieves highest branch coverage 97.16% and line coverage 98.65% on Java focal methods. Fine-tuned Llama-2 also evaluated.

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Unit Tests with Mutation Testing: ChatGPT vs DeepSeek
abstract: GPT-4o vs DeepSeek V3 on six Java Defects4J classes. GPT-4o mutation score 85.61% on Primes class (medium CC). PIT mutation tool. MC and MS both measured.

title: HITS: High-coverage LLM-based Unit Test Generation via Method Slicing
abstract: Method-slicing approach for LLM test generation. +19.80% branch coverage +20.92% mutation score vs baseline. Java Defects4J. JaCoCo + PIT.

title: Exploring the Capability of ChatGPT in Test Generation
abstract: Empirical study ChatGPT test generation capability. Coverage and mutation adequacy on Java programs. Comparable to traditional automated tools. IEEE QRS 2023.
authors: Yi G.; Chen Z.; Chen Z.; Wong W.E.; Chau N.

title: AgoneTest: Automated Evaluation Framework for LLM-Generated Unit Tests in Java
abstract: AgoneTest framework Classes2Test dataset. LLM tests match human-written when compiled. Test smells analysis included. Direct comparison LLM vs human-written Java tests.

title: CoverUp: Effective High Coverage Test Generation for Python
abstract: Coverage-driven LLM test generation for Python. Per-module median line+branch coverage 80% vs CodaMosa 47%. Overall line+branch coverage 89% vs MuTAP 77%. ACM PACMSE 2025.

title: Establishing Meta-Requirements and Design Principles for LLM-based Unit Test Generation
abstract: DSR approach to improve LLM unit test generation. GPT-4 Claude 3.5 Llama 3.1 evaluated. Java+Python. Coverage and mutation score measured. Design principles proposed.

title: AI-Powered Unit Test Generation via Multi-LLM Chaining
abstract: Multi-LLM chaining GPT-4o + Gemini. Java HumanEval dataset. Branch coverage 99.05%; mutation coverage 94.32%. JaCoCo + PIT.

title: EvoGPT: Enhancing Test Suite Robustness via LLM-Based Generation and Genetic Optimization
abstract: Combines LLM generation with genetic optimization for test suite robustness. Average 10% improvement in both code coverage and mutation score on multiple Java open-source projects.

title: Impact of Code Context and Prompting Strategies on Automated Unit Test Generation with Modern LLMs
abstract: Evaluates prompting strategies zero-shot vs chain-of-thought for unit test generation. Best: 96.3% branch coverage 57% average mutation score using Gemini 2.5 Pro. Java and Python.

title: How well LLM-based test generation techniques perform with newer LLM versions?
abstract: Evaluates newer LLM versions (GPT-4o-mini) replacing older models in existing frameworks. Branch coverage and mutation score via JaCoCo and PIT on Java. ACM FSE 2025.

title: An Exploratory Study on Using Large Language Models for Mutation Testing
abstract: GPT-4-Turbo best for mutant generation. GPT-4 outperforms GPT-3.5 CodeLlama StarChat. 96.7% bug detection on Defects4J. Java mutation testing study.

title: Seed&Steer: Guiding LLMs with Compilable Prefix and Branch Signals for Unit Test Generation
abstract: Seed&Steer combines EvoSuite seeds with LLM. 73% branch coverage across Java focal methods varying complexity. Compilation rate improved 7%. Five real-world Java projects.

title: Software Testing with Large Language Models: Survey Landscape and Vision
abstract: Survey of LLMs for software testing including unit test generation. Covers branch coverage mutation score trends. IEEE TSE 2024. Secondary study — survey paper.
